description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller for user management, including user registration, retrieval, and deletion endpoints.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Spring Boot REST controller handling user registration, retrieval, and deletion for admin endpoints.

methods.name: registerUser
methods.description: Handles POST request to register a new user and returns the created user response.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a list of all users.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to delete a user by ID.
